purpose: Teach: ことわざ/虫歯/ふんだんに/かぶり/豆乳/もてる/そういや/覗く

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ことわざ、好きなのよ、絶対、本気で、いっぱい、教えてあげるね、約束、絶対、本気で、本気。
lines.en: Sho, I'm really serious—I absolutely love proverbs, and I'm going to teach you so many. Promise.
lines.style: Warm, generous opening. Voice lifts on 'love'—genuine delight. Slow, deliberate pace to show sincerity. Trailing softness at the end like a guarantee.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、虫歯、ないんだよ、メイ姉さん、ちゃんと、本気で、絶対、歯磨き、してるからね、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: I don't have any cavities, Mei-sis. I brush my teeth really well, every time. Absolutely.
lines.style: Small proud voice, matter-of-fact. Quick, efficient delivery on the facts. Slight lift at 'Mei-sis' like he's sharing good news with someone he respects.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お弁当、本気で、絶対、ふんだんに、お菓子、入れてあげたわよ、翔くん、メイ姉さん、絶対、本気で、楽しんでね、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Your lunch today is packed with sweets, Sho. I made sure of it. Enjoy it for me, okay? Really.
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial. Soft on the opening. Gentle emphasis on 'packed with'—she's pleased with herself. Trailing fadeout like she's savoring his future reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今日、ぼく、本気で、絶対、新しい帽子、絶対、かぶりに、入れてきたよ、メイ姉さん、見て、可愛い?本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, I wore my new hat today. Look—do you think it's cute? Really?
lines.style: Bright, eager voice. Quick delivery, almost breathless. Seeks validation on 'cute' with a small upward lift. Trailing off into genuine doubt—he really wants to know what she thinks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、豆乳ラテ、最近、はまってるのよ、翔くん、健康に、絶対、本気で、いいわよね、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: I've gotten really into soy milk lattes lately, Sho. It's good for your health, you know? I've been thinking about that.
lines.style: Reflective, conversational tone. Slight pause before 'soy milk lattes' like she's sharing something she's noticed about herself. Warm but thoughtful. Trails off gently into the health note.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、もてる人だよね、お母さんが、いつも、言ってるよ、ぼく、絶対、本気で、誇り、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Mei-sis is someone people like, isn't she? Your mom says that all the time. I'm really proud of you for noticing.
lines.style: Pleased but genuine surprise at his observation. Not fishing for compliments. Warm on 'proud'—making him feel seen. Steady, even delivery, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そういや、翔くん、本気で、絶対、お誕生日、近いわよね?メイ姉さん、絶対、お祝い、本気で、用意してるからね、約束、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Your birthday's coming up soon, isn't it? I've already started getting your gift ready. I promise.
lines.style: Anticipatory, a little excited. Opens with gentle realization. Emphasis on 'already'—she's been thinking ahead. Confident close on the promise, like a secret she's keeping just for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の柵から、本気で、絶対、池を、覗くこと、してみたいんだ、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、一緒に、行ってくれる?お願い、絶対、本気、本気で。
lines.en: I want to look at the pond from the park fence with you. Will you come with me, Mei-sis? Please?
lines.style: Quiet, vulnerable request. Soft opening on 'pond'—slightly uncertain. Small pause before 'Will you come'—he's checking if it's a big ask. Trailing plea on the end, genuine hope underneath.
